turns.text: I'd love to help you out, but I have a dentist appointment.
turns.zh: 我很想帮你，但我约了牙医。

turns.text: That's such a great way to decline.
turns.zh: 这拒绝方式也太妙了吧。

turns.text: This shows that he feels bad that he can't help.
turns.zh: 这说明他因为帮不上忙而感到过意不去。

turns.text: It's not that he doesn't want to.
Then he used the phrase, "I'd love to, but this is maybe the most important part.
turns.zh: 然后他用了这个说法：「我很想，但」——这可能是最关键的部分。

turns.text: You're telling the person, "My desire is to help you." And then the butt explains why you can't,
turns.zh: 你是在告诉对方：「我的意愿是想帮你。」然后那个「但是」解释了为什么你帮不了。
